Lore's web UI uses one WebSocket per browser tab, served by lore-api at `/api/ws` (configured as `LORE_WS_URL`, `wss://<lore-api host>/api/ws`). The socket carries named channels as JSON text frames. A `run` channel forwards an assembly run's pod events and transcript to every viewer registered for that run. A `plan` channel tunnels the plan editor's Hocuspocus collaboration bytes to the same collaboration server. The collab-token handshake still happens inside the tunnel.

The web-ui keeps the socket in a provider above every page, so going from a plan to its run keeps the connection. A `run` channel opens with a run-bound token. The token comes from `POST /api/assembly-runs/{id}/stream-token` and is stored as a sha256 in `lore.live_tokens` (migration 0091). On the server there is one feed per run, subscribed once to the Postgres NOTIFY hub, instead of one session per connection.

This replaced the earlier SSE stream (ADR-037). The SSE route, the web-ui SSE proxy and the `EventSource` hook were deleted. The frame contract and row-id cursor are unchanged.
